shadowSentences: I love to read books in my free time.
The weather today is quite nice and sunny.
I enjoy cooking new recipes on the weekends.
Traveling to new places always excites me.
My favorite movie genre is science fiction and fantasy.
Listening to music helps me relax after a long day.
I often go for walks in the park during the evenings.
Learning a new language can be both fun and challenging.
I try to exercise regularly to stay healthy and fit.
Spending time with family and friends brings me joy and happiness.

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about leisure activities.
questions: Q1: What is your favorite leisure activity and why do you enjoy it?
Q2: Have you ever faced any challenges while pursuing this activity?
Q3: In your opinion, how important are leisure activities for a balanced life?
Q4: What advice would you give someone looking to start a new leisure activity?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about eco-friendly habits.
questions: Q1: Can you share an eco-friendly habit you practice in your daily life?
Q2: What challenges do you face when trying to be more environmentally friendly?
Q3: How do you think individual actions can impact the environment?
Q4: What recommendations would you give to someone wanting to adopt eco-friendly habits?

interviewScenarios.intro: You have agreed to take part in a research study about volunteer work.
questions: Q1: Have you ever participated in volunteer work? If so, what did you do?
Q2: What obstacles did you encounter while volunteering?
Q3: Why do you believe volunteering is important for communities?
Q4: What suggestions would you offer to someone considering volunteering for the first time?
